channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Culdcept BEGINS
item.description: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

item.title: Liar's Bar
item.description: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

item.title: Nomad Drive
item.description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

item.title: Northgard Battlegrounds
item.description: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

item.title: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
item.description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

item.title: Songs of Conquest - Yulan
item.description: The beautiful lands of Yulan are rich in history and culture, but deeply fractured. Once divided, the three great houses, Li, Sheng, and Xuan, must now unite to defeat their ancient enemies.

item.title: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire
item.description: Build a criminal empire from the streets up. Commit crimes in third-person, run and automate illegal businesses, recruit your own crime family, fight rival organizations, and take control of a seamless open-world city.

item.title: Vampy's Big Day
item.description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

item.title: The Last Faith
item.description: Dive into the latest evolution of The Last Faith: a dark and gothic fusion of metroidvania and soulslike. Engage in merciless and precise combat with a huge range of weapons, firearms, and custom executions. Let nothing stand in the way of your journey to salvation.

item.title: Alisa
item.description: Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90s 3D games.

item.title: Divine Frequency
item.description: A fever dream experience about the total collapse of reality as it lingers between states of erasure and transcendence.

item.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
item.description: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it's not just your own life that’s on the line this time.

item.title: Fran Bow
item.description: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

item.title: Huntsman
item.description: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

item.title: Little Goody Two Shoes
item.description: Venture into the woods as you play Little Goody Two Shoes, a phantasmagorical horror narrative adventure where all your decisions matter!

item.title: Little Misfortune
item.description: Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

item.title: MADiSON
item.description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

item.title: Active Matter
item.description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

item.title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
item.description: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

item.title: Blue Ridge Hunting
item.description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

item.title: Clock Tower: Rewind
item.description: The 16-bit nightmare returns. Survive, hide, and avoid the deadly Scissorman in this legendary horror classic.

item.title: CRACK
item.description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

item.title: Crisol: Theater of Idols
item.description: Crisol is a survival horror adventure set in a twisted version of Spain. As a soldier captured by religious dogmatism, you must use your own blood as ammunition, without draining to the point of death. Explore the cursed island of Tormentosa, uncover dark secrets, and battle horrifying enemies.

item.title: CRYO
item.description: CRYO is a multiplayer co-op survival horror for 1-4 players. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault...

item.title: DEVOUR
item.description: DEVOUR is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop possessed cultists before they drag you to hell. Run. Scream. Hide. Just don't get caught.

item.title: Fangtopia
item.description: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.

item.title: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
item.description: Jack Nelson, a 24-year-old fire lookout, transferred to a new outpost. As he settled into his new home, he couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, little did he know what was transpiring down in Ironbark State Park.

item.title: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
item.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

item.title: Giggleland
item.description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

item.title: Labyrinthine
item.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

item.title: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
item.description: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventure‑puzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

item.title: Magical Girl ER
item.description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

item.title: MemeticBox
item.description: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.

item.title: My Friendly Neighborhood
item.description: Something scary is happening with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show, The Friendly Neighborhood! Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

item.title: Night Plane
item.description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

item.title: Planet Coaster 2: Silver Screen Pack
item.description: Craft spectacular movie sets and cinematic backdrops to bring your silver screen adventures to life. Create the metropolis of your dreams with striking skyscrapers, rich gold detailing, and sleek stucco finishes.

item.title: Punch Upon a Time
item.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

item.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
item.description: Embark on an original story, prequel to the award-winning games: A Plague Tale. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.

item.title: Scramble Knights Online
item.description: Adventure with friends in this MMO-lite action RPG! Explore the shared online kingdom of Terracott as a knight-in-training. Party up to conquer dungeons, slay monsters, discover rare loot, and return home to forge powerful new gear before setting out on your next quest.

item.title: ShredDead
item.description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

item.title: Soul Mates
item.description: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

item.title: Stygian: Outer Gods
item.description: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and every decision counts now, are you up to the task?

item.title: The Mailroom
item.description: Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.

item.title: Tidy Farm
item.description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

item.title: Trivia Murder Party 3
item.description: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.
